DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計を承ります。こちらが伝票です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your payment. Here is the bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そばはいただきましたが、この小鉢は来ていません。注文には入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 伝票にある小鉢が未提供だったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I had the soba, but this small side dish never came. It is included in the order, though.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the small side dish listed on the bill was not served. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し訳ありません。厨房の記録を確認します。まだお席へお持ちしていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'm sorry. I'll check the kitchen record. It hasn't been brought to your table yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これから出していただけるなら食べたいです。どのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提供までの時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: If you can serve it now, I'd like to eat it. How long will it take?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how long it will take to serve the dish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 五分ほどです。お急ぎでしたら、小鉢を取り消してお会計を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: About five minutes. If you're in a hurry, we can cancel the side dish and correct the bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: すぐ出発したいので、今回は取り消してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発時間を理由に小鉢を取り消す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to leave straight away, so please cancel it this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Cancel the side dish because you need to leave. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。小鉢の分を除いた伝票をお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. I'll give you a bill with the side dish removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい伝票を見ました。そばとご飯だけになっています。ご飯は一杯で合っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正伝票のそばとご飯の品目とご飯の数量を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked the new bill. It only has soba and rice now. One bowl of rice is correct, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that the corrected bill lists soba and rice and confirm the quantity of rice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。一杯分です。こちらの合計でお支払いをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, one bowl. Please pay this total.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この金額を現金で払います。食事はおいしかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正後の金額を支払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll pay this amount in cash. The food was delicious.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay the corrected amount. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待たせして失礼しました。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting. Thank you. Please visit us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまでお送りしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where would you like me to take you?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 文化会館へお願いします。この箱は中の模型が動くので、倒さずに運びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 模型入りの箱を立てたまま目的地へ運びたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: To the cultural hall, please. The model inside this box can shift, so I'd like to transport it without tipping it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to transport a box containing a model upright to your destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の底が平らですね。後ろへ積む前に、高さを見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bottom of the box is flat. May I check its height before loading it in the back?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。上に書いた矢印が上向きになるようにお願いします。重ねる荷物はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上向きの印と他の荷物の有無を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Please keep the arrow drawn on the top pointing upward. I don't have any other luggage to stack on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the upward-pointing mark and whether you have other luggage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この向きなら入ります。急な揺れを避けるため、少し遠回りでも大きな道を使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It will fit this way up. Would you prefer larger roads to avoid sudden jolts, even if it means a slight detour?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時間には余裕があります。大きな道でお願いします。箱の横に座って押さえる必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きな道を選び箱の支え方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have plenty of time. Please take the larger roads. Do I need to sit beside the box and hold it steady?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose larger roads and ask how the box will be supported. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物はこちらで固定します。お客様は座席に座ってベルトをお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll secure the luggage. Please sit in a seat and use the seat belt.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。会館の正面に階段があるので、搬入口の近くで降ろしてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 搬入口付近での降車を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see. There are stairs at the front of the hall, so I'd like to be dropped off near the delivery entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to be dropped off near the delivery entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 搬入口の場所が分かる図はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have a map showing where the delivery entrance is?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内図の裏側です。着いたら、止められる所で箱を一緒に出していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 搬入口の図を示し荷下ろしの手伝いを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's at the back on this map. When we arrive, could you help me take out the box somewhere we can stop?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the delivery entrance on the map and ask for help unloading. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました、積み込みを済ませて参ります。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll go and finish loading it. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の案内図をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at a map of the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: コウモリの展示を見たいです。暗い部屋に入る前に、出入口の位置を知っておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗い展示室の出入口の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the bat exhibit. Before entering the dark room, I'd like to know where the entrance and exit are.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the entrance and exit of the dark exhibition room are. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口と出口は別です。この曲がった通路を通って、展示室へ入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The entrance and exit are separate. You go through this curved passage to enter the exhibition room.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ入口へ戻るのではないのですね。見学を短くして出口へ進むこともできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短い見学で出口へ進めるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I don't return through the same entrance. Can I keep my visit short and go on to the exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can leave through the exit after a short visit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: できます。右の通路をそのまま進むと出口です。足元の小さな灯りが目印になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Follow the passage on the right straight on to the exit. The small lights near the floor will guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その灯りを見て進みます。室内で撮影せず、まず目で見ようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 足元の灯りを目印にし撮影せず見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll follow those lights. I think I'll just look with my own eyes first, without taking photos inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will follow the floor lights and look without taking photos. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影については入口の表示をご覧ください。説明板は室外にもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the sign at the entrance about photography. There are information panels outside the room, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 室内で文字を読むのが難しそうなので、先に外の説明板を読んでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 室外で説明を先に読むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It looks difficult to read inside, so I'll read the information panels outside first.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to read the information outside first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: コウモリの活動時間もそこに書いてあります。今は休んでいる個体が多いですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The bats' active hours are written there, too. Many of them are resting now.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休んでいる姿を静かに見ます。長く立ち止まらず、右の通路から出ますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休む動物を短く見て出口へ進む予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll quietly watch them resting. I won't stop for long, and I'll leave through the passage on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to briefly watch the resting animals and proceed to the exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ごゆっくりご覧ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Please take your time looking. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 日用品の売場で、お探しの物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for anything in the household goods section?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薄いブラウスを洗うネットが欲しいです。この二つは網目が違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄いブラウス用のネットと網目の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a laundry net for washing a thin blouse. These two have different mesh sizes, don't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a net for a thin blouse and the difference in mesh size. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは細かい網目、もう一つは大きい網目です。衣類の表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one has fine mesh, and the other has larger mesh. Please also check the garment's care label.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ブラウスにはネット使用とあります。細かい方で、畳んだ服がゆったり入る大きさを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 衣類の表示を伝え収納できる見本を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The blouse label says to use a net. I'd like to see a fine-mesh one large enough for the folded blouse to fit loosely.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the garment's care label and ask to see a sample that will fit it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きさの見本はこちらです。ファスナーの端をしまう所もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the size samples. There's also a place to tuck away the end of the zipper.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに金具を隠せるのですね。閉めた時に引っ掛からないか、見本で試してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ファスナーをしまう操作を試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I can hide the metal part here. May I try the sample to check that it won't snag when closed?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to try tucking away the zipper on the sample. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。端まで閉めてから、この布の下へ金具を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Close it all the way, then put the metal part under this piece of fabric.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 閉められました。これは乾燥機にも使えますか。服の表示もあとで確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ネットの乾燥機対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've closed it. Can this also go in a tumble dryer? I'll check the garment's label later, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the laundry net can be used in a dryer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ネットの袋には乾燥機不可と書いてあります。お洗濯の後は服を出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The net's packaging says it cannot be tumble-dried. Please remove the clothes after washing.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乾燥機には入れません。この細かい網目の大きい物を一枚ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乾燥機を避けると伝えて商品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't put it in the dryer. One of these large, fine-mesh nets, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid the dryer and choose the product. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらの商品をレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take this product to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に関する郵便のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about mail when moving home?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週引っ越します。今の郵便受けの名前は、いつ外すのがよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居前の郵便受けの氏名表示について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm moving next week. I'm not sure when I should remove my name from my current mailbox.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the name displayed on your mailbox before moving. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便受けの表示については建物の管理者にもご相談ください。転送の届出はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consult the building manager about the mailbox label, too. Have you submitted a mail-forwarding notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。先に名前を外せば、新しい住所へ届くと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示撤去と転送を混同していたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought removing my name first would make the mail go to my new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused removing the name label with mail forwarding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前の表示だけでは新しい住所への転送は始まりません。届出の案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Removing the name label alone won't start forwarding to your new address. I'll give you instructions on submitting the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内をお願いします。今の部屋を借りている期間が、引っ越し後も一週間あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転送案内を求め旧居の契約期間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please give me the instructions. My lease on the current room continues for a week after I move.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for forwarding instructions and explain how long your old lease continues. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届出には転送を希望する開始日を書く欄があります。どの日からにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The notice has a field for your preferred forwarding start date. Which day would you like it to start?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を運ぶ日からにしたいです。それまでに今の郵便受けへ入った物は、自分で取りに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転送開始希望日と旧郵便受け確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: From the day I move my belongings. I'll collect anything delivered to my current mailbox before then myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your preferred forwarding start date and that you will check the old mailbox. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開始日以外に、今の住所と新しい住所もお書きください。名前の表示は管理者へ確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Besides the start date, please write both your current and new addresses. Check with the manager about the name label.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの住所を用意して届出を進めます。古い郵便受けの確認日も決めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所を用意し届出と残った郵便の確認を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll get both addresses ready and go ahead with the notice. I'll also decide when to check the old mailbox.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the addresses and proceed with the notice and checking for remaining mail. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内はこちらです。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the instructions. Thank you for consulting us. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the exhibits?

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明カードに照明が映って文字が読みにくいです。展示を触って動かすのではなく、読む場所を変えてみたいです。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 反射で説明カードが読めず展示を動かさず読む位置を変えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lighting reflects on the information card, making the text hard to read. Rather than touch and move the exhibit, I'd like to try reading it from a different position.
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that glare makes the information card hard to read and ask about changing your viewing position without moving the exhibit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのカードでしょうか。こちらから見え方を確かめます。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which card is it? I'll check how it looks from here.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この模型の手前です。正面では中央が白く光り、少し右へ動くと見えますが、通路をふさいでしまいます。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正面の反射と右側では通路をふさぐ状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one in front of this model. From directly in front, the center has a white glare. I can see it if I move a little to the right, but then I block the passage.
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the glare from the front and that standing to the right blocks the passage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 後ろの説明シートでも同じ内容を読めます。展示と交互にご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-05.translation: The information sheet behind you has the same content. Would you like to alternate between it and the exhibit?

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、先にシートで部品の名前を読み、模型へ戻って形を確認したいです。全部覚えてから見る必要はありませんね。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別シートで部品名を読み模型で形を確認したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to read the part names on the sheet first, then return to the model to check their shapes. I don't need to memorize everything before looking, right?
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to read the part names on a separate sheet and check the shapes on the model. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自由に行き来できます。シートを持って模型の前へ来る場合は、周囲の方と距離を取ってください。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can move back and forth freely. If you bring the sheet to the model, please keep some distance from other visitors.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙を模型に置かず、自分で持ちます。見終えたら元の場所へ戻します。シートへ書き込みはしません。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: シートを自分で持ち展示に置かず書き込まず戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll hold the sheet myself rather than put it on the model. I'll return it when I'm done and won't write on it.
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will hold the sheet, not put it on the exhibit or write on it, and return it afterward. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身のメモ用紙でしたら、気になった部品名を書けます。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can write down part names you're interested in on your own notepaper.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部品名を自分の紙に控えます。シートで読み、模型で位置を見て、分からない名前をあとで質問します。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の紙へ部品名を控え模型で位置を見て不明名を質問すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the part names on my own paper. I'll read the sheet, look at where the parts are on the model, and ask about any names I don't understand afterward.
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the part names on your own paper, check their positions on the model, and ask about unfamiliar names. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 説明シートをご利用ください。展示との行き来もできます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-IBR-BANDO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the information sheet. You can go back and forth between it and the exhibit. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日の作業で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with today's work?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: みんなの休憩用のかばんが、収穫箱を運ぶ通路に出ています。足元が狭いので、荷物を置く場所を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩かばんが収穫箱運搬通路を狭めるため置場を変えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Everyone's break-time bags are sticking out into the passage used to carry harvest boxes. There's not much room for our feet, so I'd like to change where the bags are kept.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about moving the break-time bags because they narrow the passage for transporting harvest boxes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場所でしょうか。持ち主は近くにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where is that? Are the owners nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 畑の入口です。私のかばんも含め三つあり、二人はまだ畑にいます。私の物だけどけても通路は狭いままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口に三つあり自分以外の二人は畑で自分分だけでは解決しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the field entrance. There are three, including mine, and the other two people are still in the field. Moving only mine would leave the passage narrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there are three bags at the entrance, the other two owners are in the field, and moving yours alone will not solve the problem. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空いている置場を担当と確認しましょう。他の方の荷物は本人に声をかけてから移してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the person in charge for an available storage area. Speak to the owners before moving other people's belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず自分のかばんを手元に取り、二人へ声をかけます。中を開けて飲物だけ取り出すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の物を取り他の持ち主へ声をかけ中身は触らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'll first take my own bag and speak to the two people. I won't open their bags just to take out their drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take your own bag, speak to the other owners, and not touch the contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休憩所の棚が使えます。通路に残らないよう、棚の中へ収めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the shelf in the break area. Put the bags fully inside the shelf so nothing remains in the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人に棚の場所を伝え、それぞれ持って行ってもらいます。すぐ戻れない人がいたら、移してよいか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棚位置を知らせ各自移し戻れぬ人には移動許可を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell both people where the shelf is and have each move their own bag. If someone can't come back right away, I'll ask whether I may move it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell them about the shelf, have each move their own bag, and ask permission if someone cannot return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移し終えた後、運搬する方にも通路が空いたことを伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everything has been moved, please also tell those transporting boxes that the passage is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三つとも棚へ収まったのを見て、箱を運ぶ人へ知らせます。次の休憩後も同じ通路へ置かないよう共有します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三つ収納後運搬者へ通路が空いたと知らせ休憩後も置場を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check that all three bags are on the shelf and tell the people carrying boxes. I'll also let everyone know not to leave bags in the same passage after the next break.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking all three bags are stored, tell the transport workers the passage is clear and share the storage location for after breaks, too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 持ち主への声がけと置場の共有で進めましょう。気付いていただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's proceed by speaking to the owners and sharing the storage location. Thank you for noticing.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you looking for something?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷蔵の豆腐を買いたいのですが、先に館内を見て回りたいです。今買って預けられるか、帰る前に買う方がよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵豆腐を買う前に見学するため預かりか後で購入か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy chilled tofu, but first I want to look around the building. Could I buy it now and leave it with you, or would it be better to buy it before leaving?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to leave purchased chilled tofu with the shop or buy it later because you want to look around first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのくらい館内にいらっしゃる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: How long do you plan to stay in the building?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四十分くらいです。その後は車で帰り、家までは十五分です。車には保冷バッグがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見学四十分帰路十五分で車に保冷バッグがあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: About forty minutes. After that I'll drive home, which takes fifteen minutes. I have an insulated cooler bag in the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will look around for forty minutes, drive home in fifteen minutes, and have a cooler bag in the car. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入品のお預かりはこの売場では行っていません。お帰り前に冷蔵売場へ戻っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This sales section doesn't hold purchased items. You can return to the chilled section before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では今は常温のお菓子だけ買い、豆腐は帰る前に選びます。在庫を必ず残してもらえるという意味ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 菓子を先に買い豆腐は後で在庫から選ぶことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll just buy shelf-stable sweets now and choose tofu before I leave. That doesn't mean you'll definitely keep some stock for me, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will buy sweets first and choose tofu from the available stock later. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、取り置きではありません。戻られた時の在庫からお選びいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right; it isn't a reservation. You can choose from the stock available when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に豆腐を車へ置いて見学するのもやめ、最後に買って保冷バッグへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 豆腐を車に置いて見学せず最後に購入し保冷バッグへ入れると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see. I won't buy tofu first and leave it in the car while looking around. I'll buy it last and put it in my cooler bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't leave tofu in the car while sightseeing, but will buy it last and put it in a cooler bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お菓子はこちらで会計できます。冷蔵品は後ほどご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can pay for the sweets here. Please look at the chilled products later.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずお菓子を会計します。見学後に売場へ戻り、豆腐を買えたらすぐ保冷バッグへ入れて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 常温品会計後見学し豆腐を買えれば保冷してすぐ帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay for the sweets first. After looking around, I'll return, and if I can buy tofu, I'll put it straight in the cooler bag and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after paying for shelf-stable items and looking around, you will chill the tofu if available and head straight home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 常温品を先にお会計します。冷蔵品はお帰り前にどうぞ。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ring up the shelf-stable items first. Please visit the chilled section before leaving. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。バスのご案内で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with bus information?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗場の案内には市民会館とありますが、バスの表示は別の名前です。同じ便か分からないので、乗る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗場案内と車両行先が違うため乗車前に同じ便か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The stop information says Civic Hall, but the bus display shows a different name. I'm not sure it's the same service, so I'd like to check before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether it is the same bus before boarding because the stop information and destination display differ. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらへ行かれますか。出発時刻も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where are you going? Do you also know the departure time?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市民会館です。案内で見たのは十時二十分発です。バスの表示は中央車庫となっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 市民会館目的で十時二十分便と中央車庫表示を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: To Civic Hall. The information I saw was for the ten twenty departure. The bus display says Central Depot.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are going to Civic Hall on the ten twenty service and that the bus displays Central Depot. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の停留所と終点の表示が違う場合があります。こちらでその便の停留所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: An intermediate stop can have a different name from the destination displayed. I'll check this service's stops.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。市民会館が途中にあるかを知りたいです。終点まで乗れば着くと考えていたので、降りる場所も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 市民会館が途中にあるかと終点まで乗る必要を確認したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'd like to know whether Civic Hall is an intermediate stop. I thought staying on until the terminus would get me there, so I'd also like to check where to get off.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check whether Civic Hall is an intermediate stop and whether you need to ride to the terminus. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内では市民会館を通る便です。運行当日の案内も乗務員へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: According to this information, this service goes via Civic Hall. Please also check the day's operating information with the driver.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗る時に市民会館で降りたいと伝えます。車庫まで行く必要はないと分かったので、車内の停留所案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗務員へ降車先を伝え車内案内を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell the driver when boarding that I want to get off at Civic Hall. Now that I know I don't need to go to the depot, I'll listen to the stop announcements on board.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell the driver your stop and listen to the on-board announcements. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご乗車後は、目的の停留所が案内されたら降車の合図をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: After boarding, please signal to get off when your stop is announced.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十時二十分の便であることをもう一度確認し、市民会館へ行くか乗務員に聞いてから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発便と経由を乗務員に再確認後乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll confirm once more that it's the ten twenty service and ask the driver whether it goes to Civic Hall before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will reconfirm the departure and route with the driver before boarding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 便と途中停留所の確認ですね。乗務員にもお声がけください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're checking the service and intermediate stops, then. Please speak to the driver as well. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。家電選びのお手伝いをしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you choose an appliance?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 掃除機の細いノズルをなくしました。本体は動くので、同じ掃除機を買い直すより、付属品だけ入手できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 掃除機は動くので紛失ノズルだけ入手できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lost the narrow nozzle for my vacuum cleaner. The cleaner still works, so I'd like to know whether I can get just the accessory rather than buy the same vacuum again.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about getting only the lost nozzle because the vacuum cleaner itself still works. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メーカーと型番は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the manufacturer and model number?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本体の裏を写真に撮りました。この文字が型番だと思います。箱に書かれた品名とは少し違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 裏面型番写真を見せ箱の品名とは違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took a photo of the underside of the cleaner. I think these characters are the model number. It's slightly different from the product name on the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show a photo of the model number on the underside and explain that it differs from the product name on the box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の表示を確認します。似た形でも接続部が違うことがあるため、本体の型番で調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the label in the photo. Even similar-looking parts can have different connectors, so I'll search using the cleaner's model number.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見た目だけで選ばず、この型番に使える物を探してください。純正品が注文できるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見た目でなく型番適合と純正品注文可否を調べてほしいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please find one compatible with this model number rather than choosing by appearance alone. I'd also like to know whether an original manufacturer's part can be ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check model compatibility rather than appearance and whether an original manufacturer's part can be ordered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取寄せの可否と価格は確認が必要です。今日は確認だけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need to check availability for special order and the price. Would you like just an inquiry today?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、価格と受取りまでの目安を聞いてから決めます。確認前に注文を確定するつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 価格と受取目安を聞いてから決め今日は確認のみと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll decide after hearing the price and estimated collection time. I don't intend to finalize an order before those are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that today you only want an inquiry and will decide after learning the price and estimated collection time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 結果の連絡方法を受付で伺えます。型番の写真は担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Reception can ask how you would like to be contacted with the result. Please show the model-number photo to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真を見せ、細いノズルだけ必要だと伝えます。適合する品と価格を聞き、注文する場合はその時に返事をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真と必要部品を担当へ示し適合価格確認後に注文返答すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the photo and explain that I only need the narrow nozzle. I'll ask about a compatible part and the price, and if I decide to order, I'll let them know then.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the staff the photo and required part, check compatibility and price, and then respond about ordering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 付属品の適合と取寄せ相談ですね。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You'd like advice about accessory compatibility and special orders. I'll direct you to the staff member. Thank you for consulting us.
